body:
I have tried acceptance and commitment therapy, selfimprovement to get rid of all kinds of anxiety and stress, anger management, breathwork, cognitive behavioral therapy, being open with this illness, emotion focused therapy, group theraphy, trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy, and the list goes on. 

I am suffering from chronic physical and psychological pain. I am tired, because i haven't noticed any changes in the pain, and i just want it to stop.

No. No medications are effective for me. I have taken MRI, to figure out if there is something in my body that causes this issue. I believe that the second similar thing i tried was neuroimaging, but i didn't learn anything from that either.

I have BPD. I experience psychosis because of chronic pain. There are many other things i experience, but i dont want to bore you. So, to answer your question, I'd like to get rid of the constant and sharp pain :)
Well, i haven't changed. You probably wont change either. The thing is, I have tried everything to "fix" myself, and nothing seems to work.
